note: LifeXP's own game, written in this repo (docs/v2/PLAN.md 9.1, rr-b): Rush's fourth mode, an original robot-style runner in a neon city — not a vendored copy, so no VENDORED.json. Its CSP is in index.html; tests/vendor-game.spec.js checks it like a vendored game's. Its engine (levels, game states, records, validator, renderer, page) is shared with the other Rush modes in v2/public/games/_engine/; its orbs and pads are Flip Rush's.
